thesis: The episode argues that Nintendo has transformed from a hit-driven business into a secular growth juggernaut by shifting to an Apple-like iterative hardware model that ensures its installed base continually grows rather than resetting to zero. This transformation allows the company to benefit from higher margin digital distribution and sell high-margin software to an ever-growing user base, giving it a durable edge in an industry where intellectual property is king.
